lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Keeping a Tired Group Going After the Kitchens Close
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Encourage a hungry, tired group and commit to a clear plan for finding food during the afternoon closure.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: You are leading a walking group in Granada, and the AI is Paco, a bar owner whose kitchen is closed: ask about the nearby food options, then encourage your group with ¡ánimo! and commit to a clear plan using the future (encontraremos, iremos).
lessons.title: Keep the Group Moving After Kitchens Close
lessons.objective: Encourage a tired, hungry group and commit to a clear plan for finding food during this afternoon closure.
lessons.focus: Use on trouvera, nous irons and attendez-moi to promise a next step and keep the group together.
lessons.scene: Maya leads a walking group past a café whose kitchen has closed for the afternoon.

cards.en: Come on, we are almost there!

cards.fr: Dans dix minutes, on trouvera quelque chose à manger.
cards.en: In ten minutes, we will find something to eat.

cards.fr: Nous irons d’abord à la boulangerie.
cards.en: We will go to the bakery first.
Wait for me here, in the shade.

reader.speaker: Group member
reader.fr: J’ai faim et je suis fatigué. La cuisine est fermée ?
reader.en: I am hungry and tired. Is the kitchen closed?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Oui, pour cet après-midi. Courage, on y est presque !
reader.en: Yes, for this afternoon. Come on, we are almost there!

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Excusez-moi, y a-t-il une boulangerie encore ouverte près d’ici ?
reader.en: Excuse me, is there a bakery still open nearby?

reader.speaker: Café owner
reader.fr: Oui, elle est deux rues plus loin. Elle ferme dans une heure.
reader.en: Yes, it is two streets farther. It closes in an hour.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Merci. La boulangerie vend-elle des sandwichs ?
reader.en: Thank you. Does the bakery sell sandwiches?

reader.speaker: Café owner
reader.fr: Oui. Il y a aussi une épicerie à côté.
reader.en: Yes. There is also a grocery shop next door.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Nous irons d’abord à la boulangerie. Dans dix minutes, on trouvera quelque chose à manger.
reader.en: We will go to the bakery first. In ten minutes, we will find something to eat.

reader.speaker: Group member
reader.fr: D’accord. On vous suit.
reader.en: All right. We will follow you.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Attendez-moi ici, à l’ombre. Je reviens tout de suite avec l’adresse.
reader.en: Wait for me here, in the shade. I will be right back with the address.

speaking.goal: Ask the café owner what is open, encourage the group and commit to the nearby bakery plan with a clear time and meeting point.
speaking.closure: Nous irons d’abord à la boulangerie.
wordBank: Dans dix minutes, on trouvera quelque chose à manger.
Nous irons d’abord à la boulangerie.

see.cueEnglish: Find the French term for bakery.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French term for tiredness.

say.cueEnglish: Ask whether the bakery is open.

write.cueEnglish: Write the plan to go to the bakery first.

lessons.internalReviewNote: The bakery availability, closing time and ten-minute travel are fictional scene facts. Review future tense and encouragement register.

lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: One Table, Three Registers: Lunch with a Chilean Family
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Switch between usted and tú as you talk with grandparents, cousins and the host during a family lunch.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: You are a guest at a Sunday lunch in Santiago, and the AI plays grandmother Doña Eliana, cousin Matías and host Valentina: talk with each of them, using usted with the grandmother and tú with the others, and soften requests with quisiera, ¿le molestaría...? and ¿me pasas...?
lessons.title: Switch Register at a Family Lunch
lessons.objective: Use formal vous with a grandmother and informal tu with a cousin and host during a family lunch.
lessons.focus: Choose vous, pourriez-vous and cela vous dérangerait-il with the grandmother; use tu and tu peux with peers.
lessons.scene: Maya joins a Sunday lunch hosted by Claire with Claire’s grandmother and cousin Julien.

cards.fr: Madame, pourriez-vous me donner la recette ?
cards.en: Madam, could you give me the recipe?

cards.fr: Julien, tu peux me passer le pain ?
cards.en: Julien, can you pass me the bread?
Claire, thank you for your invitation.

cards.fr: Cela vous dérangerait-il si je prenais encore un peu de quiche ?
cards.en: Would you mind if I had a little more quiche?

cards.fr: Julien, tu as préparé la salade ?
cards.en: Julien, did you prepare the salad?

reader.speaker: Claire
reader.fr: Maya, bienvenue à notre déjeuner de famille.
reader.en: Maya, welcome to our family lunch.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Claire, merci pour ton invitation.
reader.en: Claire, thank you for your invitation.

reader.speaker: Grandmother
reader.fr: Je vous en prie. Goûtez la quiche.
reader.en: You are welcome. Try the quiche.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Madame, elle est délicieuse. Pourriez-vous me donner la recette ?
reader.en: Madam, it is delicious. Could you give me the recipe?

reader.speaker: Grandmother
reader.fr: Avec plaisir. Vous voulez encore un peu de quiche ?
reader.en: With pleasure. Would you like a little more quiche?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Oui, merci. Cela vous dérangerait-il si j’en prenais encore un peu ?
reader.en: Yes, thank you. Would you mind if I had a little more?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Julien, tu peux me passer le pain ?
reader.en: Julien, can you pass me the bread?

reader.speaker: Julien
reader.fr: Bien sûr. Tu veux aussi de la salade ?
reader.en: Of course. Do you also want salad?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Oui. Tu l’as préparée ?
reader.en: Yes. Did you make it?

reader.speaker: Julien
reader.fr: Oui, avec Claire.
reader.en: Yes, with Claire.

speaking.goal: Thank the host using tu, request the recipe and more quiche using vous with the grandmother, and ask the cousin for bread using tu.
speaking.closure: Merci à tous pour ce déjeuner.
wordBank: Madame, pourriez-vous me donner la recette ?
Julien, tu peux me passer le pain ?
Cela vous dérangerait-il si je prenais encore un peu de quiche ?
Julien, tu as préparé la salade ?

see.cueEnglish: Find the formal or plural French you.

recall.cueEnglish: Recall the softened recipe request to the grandmother.

hear.cueEnglish: Listen for the informal bread request.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French term for cousin.

write.cueEnglish: Write a formal request for more quiche.

lessons.internalReviewNote: The family relationship and chosen register are specific to this fictional scene. Review register, conditional softeners and natural family address.

lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Burn from a Sizzling Skillet: Telling the Manager
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Narrate an injury in order with clear times and ask the manager to record it and point you to medical help.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: You are Ben's companion, and the AI is Lorena, the restaurant manager: tell her what happened in order with time markers like a las dos y cuarto, en ese momento, después and al rato, ask her to record it in her log, and ask where the nearest clinic is.
lessons.title: Describe a Skillet Burn to the Manager
lessons.objective: Narrate a burn in time order, ask the manager to record it, and ask where medical help is available.
lessons.focus: Use à quatorze heures quinze, à ce moment-là, ensuite and un peu plus tard for ordered past narration.
lessons.scene: At lunch, a hot cast-iron skillet handle burns Ben’s palm; Maya tells the restaurant manager what happened.

cards.fr: À quatorze heures quinze, on nous a apporté la poêle chaude.
cards.en: At a quarter past two, they brought us the hot skillet.

cards.fr: À ce moment-là, Ben a touché la poignée sans serviette.
cards.en: At that moment, Ben touched the handle without a napkin.

cards.fr: Ensuite, nous avons mis sa main sous l’eau du robinet.
cards.en: Afterward, we put his hand under tap water.

cards.fr: Un peu plus tard, une cloque est apparue sur sa paume.
cards.en: A little later, a blister appeared on his palm.

cards.fr: Pouvez-vous le noter dans votre registre des incidents ?
cards.en: Can you record it in your incident log?

cards.fr: Où se trouve le centre médical le plus proche ?
cards.en: Where is the nearest medical center?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Madame, je voudrais vous expliquer ce qui est arrivé à Ben.
reader.en: Madam, I would like to explain what happened to Ben.

reader.speaker: Manager
reader.fr: Je vous écoute. Quand cela s’est-il produit ?
reader.en: I am listening. When did it happen?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: À quatorze heures quinze, on nous a apporté une poêle en fonte chaude.
reader.en: At a quarter past two, they brought us a hot cast-iron skillet.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: À ce moment-là, Ben a touché la poignée sans serviette.
reader.en: At that moment, Ben touched the handle without a napkin.

reader.speaker: Manager
reader.fr: Que s’est-il passé ensuite ?
reader.en: What happened next?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Ensuite, nous avons mis sa main sous l’eau du robinet. Un peu plus tard, une cloque est apparue sur sa paume.
reader.en: Afterward, we put his hand under tap water. A little later, a blister appeared on his palm.

reader.speaker: Manager
reader.fr: Je vois la rougeur et la cloque.
reader.en: I see the redness and blister.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Pouvez-vous le noter dans votre registre des incidents ?
reader.en: Can you record it in your incident log?

reader.speaker: Manager
reader.fr: Oui, je vais noter l’heure et les faits.
reader.en: Yes, I will record the time and facts.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Où se trouve le centre médical le plus proche ?
reader.en: Where is the nearest medical center?

reader.speaker: Manager
reader.fr: Il est à deux rues d’ici.
reader.en: It is two streets from here.

speaking.opening: Madame, je voudrais vous expliquer ce qui est arrivé à Ben.
speaking.goal: State the exact time, hot handle, burn and blister in order; ask for an incident record and the nearest medical center.
speaking.closure: Merci de noter les faits et de m’indiquer le centre médical.
wordBank: À quatorze heures quinze, on nous a apporté la poêle chaude.
À ce moment-là, Ben a touché la poignée sans serviette.
Ensuite, nous avons mis sa main sous l’eau du robinet.
Un peu plus tard, une cloque est apparue sur sa paume.
Pouvez-vous le noter dans votre registre des incidents ?
Où se trouve le centre médical le plus proche ?

see.cueEnglish: Find the direct French term for a burn.

hear.cueEnglish: Listen for the blister on the palm.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French term for incident log.

say.cueEnglish: Ask the manager to record the incident.

write.cueEnglish: Write a question asking for the nearest medical center.

lessons.internalReviewNote: Qualified French and medical/domain review required for the burn terms and narrated event. The event and manager response are fictional; no learner-facing AI medical caution is inserted.

lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Near Miss: The Peanut Sauce Nobody Mentioned
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Talk through an allergen near miss with the server without blame and agree what both sides will check next time.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: You are Grace's friend, and the AI is Verónica, the restaurant manager: talk through the peanut sauce near miss without blaming Andrés, using casi, por poco and si no hubiera preguntado, podría haber..., and agree on what both sides will check next time.
lessons.title: Discuss a Peanut-Sauce Near Miss
lessons.objective: Explain that a guest nearly ate peanut sauce, discuss the missed ingredient without blame and agree on checks for next time.
lessons.focus: Use presque, si elle n’avait pas demandé and elle aurait pu to express a near miss and hypothetical consequence.
lessons.scene: At lunch, Grace asks about a sauce just before eating; Maya and the manager discuss the unmentioned peanuts.

cards.fr: Elle a failli manger la sauce aux cacahuètes.
cards.en: She very nearly ate the peanut sauce.

cards.fr: Grace a demandé juste à temps.
Si elle n’avait pas demandé, elle aurait pu avoir une réaction grave.
cards.en: If she had not asked, she could have had a serious reaction.

cards.fr: Nous ne cherchons pas à accuser quelqu’un.
cards.en: We are not trying to blame anyone.

cards.fr: La prochaine fois, nous confirmerons les ingrédients.
cards.en: Next time, we will confirm the ingredients.

cards.fr: Nous noterons l’allergie sur la commande.
cards.en: We will note the allergy on the order.

cards.fr: Pourriez-vous proposer un plat de remplacement ?
cards.en: Could you offer a replacement dish?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Grace a failli manger la sauce aux cacahuètes.
reader.en: Grace very nearly ate the peanut sauce.

reader.speaker: Manager
reader.fr: Je comprends. La sauce contenait des cacahuètes qui n’étaient pas mentionnées.
reader.en: I understand. The sauce contained peanuts that were not mentioned.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Grace a demandé juste à temps. Elle a une allergie aux cacahuètes.
reader.en: Grace asked just in time. She has a peanut allergy.

reader.speaker: Grace
reader.fr: J’ai mon auto-injecteur d’adrénaline avec moi.
reader.en: I have my epinephrine auto-injector with me.

reader.speaker: Manager
reader.fr: Je suis désolée. La note sur la commande ne mentionnait pas cette sauce.
reader.en: I am sorry. The note on the order did not mention this sauce.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Si elle n’avait pas demandé, elle aurait pu avoir une réaction grave.
reader.en: If she had not asked, she could have had a serious reaction.

reader.speaker: Manager
reader.fr: Que pouvons-nous vérifier la prochaine fois ?
reader.en: What can we check next time?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Nous confirmerons les ingrédients avant de commander. Nous ne cherchons pas à accuser quelqu’un.
reader.en: We will confirm the ingredients before ordering. We are not trying to blame anyone.

reader.speaker: Manager
reader.fr: Et nous noterons l’allergie sur la commande et confirmerons la sauce avec la cuisine.
reader.en: And we will note the allergy on the order and confirm the sauce with the kitchen.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Merci. Pourriez-vous proposer un plat de remplacement ?
reader.en: Thank you. Could you offer a replacement dish?

reader.speaker: Manager
reader.fr: Oui, je vais vous présenter une autre option.
reader.en: Yes, I will present another option.

speaking.opening: Grace a failli manger la sauce aux cacahuètes.
speaking.goal: Describe the unmentioned peanut sauce, state the possible serious reaction, agree on ingredient and order-note checks, and request a replacement.
speaking.closure: La prochaine fois, nous confirmerons les ingrédients.
wordBank: Elle a failli manger la sauce aux cacahuètes.
Grace a demandé juste à temps.
Si elle n’avait pas demandé, elle aurait pu avoir une réaction grave.
Nous ne cherchons pas à accuser quelqu’un.
La prochaine fois, nous confirmerons les ingrédients.
Nous noterons l’allergie sur la commande.

recall.cueEnglish: Recall how to say Grace nearly ate the sauce.

hear.cueEnglish: Listen for the hypothetical serious reaction.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French term for a peanut allergy.

say.cueEnglish: Say the group is not trying to blame anyone.

write.cueEnglish: Write what the group will confirm next time.

lessons.sourceTitleEnglish: Gas Smell at the Food Truck Park: Clear and Call
lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: Alert a vendor to a gas smell, move people away with short commands, and report it clearly on an emergency call.
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: You are a visitor at the food truck park, and the AI plays vendor Mauricio and then Daniela, the 911 operator: warn Mauricio, move people back with commands like ¡aléjense! and ¡no fumen!, and report the location clearly using si + present → future.
lessons.title: Report a Gas Smell at a Food-Truck Area
lessons.objective: Alert a vendor to a gas smell, move people back with short commands and give a clear emergency-call location.
lessons.focus: Use éloignez-vous, ne fumez pas, ne touchez à aucun interrupteur and si + present with future to report the source scene directly.
lessons.scene: At a food-truck area, Maya notices a strong gas smell near a vendor’s gas cylinder, moves people away and calls 112.

cards.fr: Il y a une forte odeur de gaz près de votre bouteille.
cards.en: There is a strong gas smell near your cylinder.

cards.fr: Éloignez-vous du camion, s’il vous plaît !
cards.en: Move away from the truck, please!

cards.fr: Ne fumez pas et n’utilisez pas de briquet !
cards.en: Do not smoke or use a lighter!

cards.fr: Nous sommes près de l’entrée principale du parking.
cards.en: We are near the main entrance to the parking lot.

cards.fr: Si quelqu’un allume une flamme, il y aura un danger.
cards.en: If someone lights a flame, there will be danger.

cards.fr: le robinet de la bouteille de gaz
Si c’est sans danger, fermez le robinet et éteignez la flamme ; ne touchez à aucun interrupteur.
cards.en: If it is safe, close the valve and put out the flame; do not touch any switch.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Monsieur, il y a une forte odeur de gaz près de votre bouteille.
reader.en: Sir, there is a strong gas smell near your cylinder.

reader.speaker: Vendeur
reader.fr: Je sens l’odeur aussi.
reader.en: I smell it too.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Si c’est sans danger, fermez le robinet et éteignez la flamme ; ne touchez à aucun interrupteur.
reader.en: If it is safe, close the valve and put out the flame; do not touch any switch.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Éloignez-vous du camion, s’il vous plaît ! Ne fumez pas et n’utilisez pas de briquet !
reader.en: Move away from the truck, please! Do not smoke or use a lighter!

reader.speaker: Vendeur
reader.fr: Je vais prévenir les autres personnes.
reader.en: I will alert the other people.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: J’appelle le 112.
reader.en: I am calling 112.

reader.speaker: Opératrice
reader.fr: Quelle est votre adresse exacte ?
reader.en: What is your exact address?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Nous sommes près de l’entrée principale du parking, à côté des camions-restaurants de la place Victor.
reader.en: We are near the main entrance to the parking lot, next to the food trucks at Place Victor.

reader.speaker: Opératrice
reader.fr: Que se passe-t-il ?
reader.en: What is happening?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Il y a une forte odeur de gaz près d’un camion. Si quelqu’un allume une flamme, il y aura un danger.
reader.en: There is a strong gas smell near a truck. If someone lights a flame, there will be danger.

reader.speaker: Opératrice
reader.fr: J’envoie les pompiers. Je note votre emplacement et les faits.
reader.en: I am sending the firefighters. I am recording your location and the facts.

speaking.goal: Alert the vendor, use the source imperative about the valve and switch, ask nearby people to move back and not smoke, then call 112 and report the exact fictional location to the operator.

lessons.internalReviewNote: Source reconciliation restored gas-cylinder valve, no-switch imperative, firefighters and the emergency-call number. The scene is localized to France, where 112 is the European emergency number (French Interior Ministry). Qualified French and gas/emergency-domain review remains required; learner-facing text mirrors the source wording without added AI caution.

internalReviewNotes: Master 11–15 preserve the Spanish Master learning purposes with French scenes and grammar. Direct burn, peanut allergy, epinephrine and emergency terms remain in teaching content.
Qualified French and relevant medical, allergen and gas/emergency-domain review remain required; all lessons are private and unregistered.
